data.title: Why Is Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) Rethinking Its Ethereum Accumulation Streak?
data.description: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (NYSE:BMNR) Chair Tom Lee signalled that the group may soon halt its record-long Ethereum accumulation streak. Lee described the current buying phase as "mature" during recent internal discussions, suggesting a possible pause in fresh Ether purchases. Any move away from aggressive accumulation would reshape how Bitmine frames Ethereum within its broader blockchain infrastructure ambitions.
